description: Juice Shop challenge 'Passkey Hijack' (Broken Access Control), candidate fix 1 is NOT a correct fix
notes: Scoping the uniqueness check to the current user (`UserId: user.id`) only prevents someone from registering the same credential twice on their own account. An attacker can still register a credential ID that belongs to a different user, which leaves the same credential ID stored for two accounts. A passkey login looks the account up by credential ID alone, so it is no longer certain whose account it ends up in.
license: MIT (c) Bjoern Kimminich & the OWASP Juice Shop contributors

description: Juice Shop challenge 'Passkey Hijack' (Broken Access Control), candidate fix 2 is NOT a correct fix
notes: Replacing the existing entry instead of updating it keeps the attacker out of the victim's account, but knowing a credential ID is still enough to act on someone else's passkey: anyone can now delete it and lock the victim out of their passkey login. The duplicate must be rejected, not resolved in favour of the newcomer.
license: MIT (c) Bjoern Kimminich & the OWASP Juice Shop contributors

description: Juice Shop challenge 'Passkey Bypass' (Broken Authentication), candidate fix 1 is NOT a correct fix
notes: Rejecting assertions without a signature only checks that one is present, not that it is valid. An attacker simply sends a forged or tampered signature, and the session is still issued regardless of what the verification returned.
license: MIT (c) Bjoern Kimminich & the OWASP Juice Shop contributors

description: Juice Shop challenge 'Passkey Bypass' (Broken Authentication), candidate fix 2 is NOT a correct fix
notes: Requiring `userVerified` only confirms the authenticator performed a user gesture (PIN, biometric, ...). It says nothing about whether the signature over the challenge is valid, so a forged-signature assertion with the UV flag set still authenticates.

export const redirectAllowlist = new Set([
  'https://github.com/juice-shop/juice-shop',
  'https://blockchain.info/address/1AbKfgvw9psQ41NbLi8kufDQTezwG8DRZm',
  'https://explorer.dash.org/address/Xr556RzuwX6hg5EGpkybbv5RanJoZN17kW',

  'https://www.stickeryou.com/products/owasp-juice-shop/794',
  'http://leanpub.com/juice-shop'
])

export const isRedirectAllowed = (url: string) => {
  let allowed = false
  for (const allowedUrl of redirectAllowlist) {
    allowed = allowed || url === allowedUrl
  }
  return allowed
